run_body3d_pose_lifter_demo: run the 3D pose lifter demo on a video or image using detection and pose estimation models
run_parse_args: run the argument parser to configure detection config, pose estimator, and pose lifter checkpoint paths
run_get_bbox: run bounding box detection on a frame using the mmdet detector with category and score thresholds
run_get_pose_est_results: run 2D pose estimation on detected bounding boxes with OKS or IoU tracking across frames
run_get_pose_lift_results: run 2D-to-3D pose lifting on a sequence of 2D poses and visualize the 3D results
